name: flowdular
description: Flowdular is an agentic foundation framework for OctaneJS: a production platform core that teams extend with modules built by AI agents.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flowdular/cli build && pnpm --filter @flowdular/cli smoke && node packages/cli/dist/index.js module sync --apply && pnpm --filter @flowdular/platform build
scripts.validate: pnpm flowdular spec validate --all && pnpm flowdular blueprint validate --all && pnpm flowdular module validate
scripts.verify: pnpm rules:check && pnpm reference:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm validate && pnpm format:check
